import math, re, workcell

cx, cy = 383.687, 263.932
s = 0.032  # hex spacing; coverage radius ~0.018 mm
dirs = [(math.cos(math.radians(60*k)), math.sin(math.radians(60*k))) for k in range(6)]
pts = [(0.0, 0.0)]
for ring in range(1, 7):
    # start at corner opposite dir 0, walk 6 sides
    x = dirs[4][0]*ring
    y = dirs[4][1]*ring
    for d in range(6):
        dx, dy = dirs[d]
        for i in range(ring):
            pts.append((x, y))
            x += dx
            y += dy

# dedupe
uniq=[]
seen=set()
for p in pts:
    key=(round(p[0],4), round(p[1],4))
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        uniq.append(p)
pts=uniq
print(f"points {len(pts)} maxr {max(math.hypot(x,y) for x,y in pts):.3f}")

pat = re.compile(r"depth ([0-9.]+) mm \(contact force ([0-9.]+) N\)")
for i,(dx,dy) in enumerate(pts):
    x, y = cx+dx*s, cy+dy*s
    r = workcell.call("robot","insert", f"{x:.4f}", f"{y:.4f}")
    st = workcell.call("robot","status").data
    print(f"{i:02d} ({x:.4f},{y:.4f}) clock={st.get('clock_s')} ok={r.ok} {r.text}")
    if r.ok:
        print("SEATED", x, y)
        break
    m = pat.search(r.text)
    if m and float(m.group(1))>0:
        print("PARTIAL", m.group(1), m.group(2))
print("done", workcell.call("robot","status").text)

from PIL import Image
from collections import deque

def blobs(path, dark_thresh=60, min_size=5, max_size=800):
    im=Image.open(path)
    px=im.load()
    w,h=im.size
    visited=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    found=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if visited[y][x]:
                continue
            r,g,b=px[x,y]
            if r>=dark_thresh or g>=dark_thresh or b>=dark_thresh:
                continue
            # flood
            q=deque([(x,y)])
            visited[y][x]=True
            pts=[]
            while q:
                cx,cy=q.popleft()
                pts.append((cx,cy))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=cx+dx,cy+dy
                    if 0<=nx<w and 0<=ny<h and not visited[ny][nx]:
                        rr,gg,bb=px[nx,ny]
                        if rr<dark_thresh and gg<dark_thresh and bb<dark_thresh:
                            visited[ny][nx]=True
                            q.append((nx,ny))
            if min_size<=len(pts)<=max_size:
                xs=[p[0] for p in pts]; ys=[p[1] for p in pts]
                found.append((sum(xs)/len(pts), sum(ys)/len(pts), len(pts), min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys)))
    return found

import math, re, workcell

cx, cy = 383.687, 263.932
s = 0.032  # hex spacing; coverage radius ~0.018 mm
dirs = [(math.cos(math.radians(60*k)), math.sin(math.radians(60*k))) for k in range(6)]
pts = [(0.0, 0.0)]
for ring in range(1, 7):
    # start at corner opposite dir 0, walk 6 sides
    x = dirs[4][0]*ring
    y = dirs[4][1]*ring
    for d in range(6):
        dx, dy = dirs[d]
        for i in range(ring):
            pts.append((x, y))
            x += dx
            y += dy

# dedupe
uniq=[]
seen=set()
for p in pts:
    key=(round(p[0],4), round(p[1],4))
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        uniq.append(p)
pts=uniq
print(f"points {len(pts)} maxr {max(math.hypot(x,y) for x,y in pts):.3f}")

pat = re.compile(r"depth ([0-9.]+) mm \(contact force ([0-9.]+) N\)")
for i,(dx,dy) in enumerate(pts):
    x, y = cx+dx*s, cy+dy*s
    r = workcell.call("robot","insert", f"{x:.4f}", f"{y:.4f}")
    st = workcell.call("robot","status").data
    print(f"{i:02d} ({x:.4f},{y:.4f}) clock={st.get('clock_s')} ok={r.ok} {r.text}")
    if r.ok:
        print("SEATED", x, y)
        break
    m = pat.search(r.text)
    if m and float(m.group(1))>0:
        print("PARTIAL", m.group(1), m.group(2))
print("done", workcell.call("robot","status").text)
